The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

Masonic Homes runs residential communities plus statewide outreach, financial support and care management programs for Masons across California, each with its own resident, member and care records.

Even where each program's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same member and resident record.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what a senior care organization Masonic Homes' size spends on technology.
